Ben / team — FYI this matches a narrow bug we saw during last quarter's Zip integration: our invite URL generator sometimes fails to percent-encode emoji and certain multi-byte UTF-8 sequences when it appends the display name as a query parameter for analytics. That results in a broken redirect at the gateway and the 'invalid percent-encoding' page.

Workarounds (short-term):
1) Admin-create the vendor record in the portal (Vendor ID created without accepting the public invite).
2) Set the vendor display name to a non-emoji ASCII variant temporarily (e.g., "Moonleaf Foods").
3) Generate a password-reset / account-activation link from the admin console (these use a different path and avoid the buggy redirect).

For the long-term fix, engineering needs to update the invite generator to run encodeURIComponent on displayName before concatenation and add a unit test for multi-byte characters. I've pulled the admin log snippet showing the failed redirect and attached it.

I'll escalate to Platform Eng for a patch; Marissa can confirm schedule if needed.

Laura Bennett
Head of Onboarding, Redwood Dedicated
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
